body:
@mvanlonden The way I understand what you're trying to do is that you need to let the user enter one value per attributeName. And the composition of all of them form a Range. 

That's why I was wondering if using a connectRange per attributeName where the min === max wouldn't do the tricks. 

```js
<InstantSearch...>
   <ConnectedRange attributeName="xxx"/> //render only one input
   <ConnectedRange attributeName="yyy"/> //render only one input
   ...
</InstantSearch>
```

If I'm wrong about your use case maybe a small mock-up of the UI and interaction would hep.
